blocks.explanation: The dependency-structure poster: fifteen steps unfold from geometry through configuration manifolds, range of motion, movement grammar, yoga, breath grammar, bandhas, autonomic regulation, the statistical manifold of mind, consciousness modulation, and musical geometry to the geometry of adaptive living. Body and music are shown to occupy the same structural position — configuration space and pitch space, movement grammar and musical grammar, motor and melodic trajectories. Breath is a compiler that turns intention into executable movement; living is coordinated navigation across multiple coupled manifolds.
blocks.tts: Motion, breath, mind, and music as one dependency structure: state space, grammar, trajectory, and adaptation, with living as navigation across coupled manifolds.
